ai_summary: **Executive Summary: 3M India Limited Q1 FY2027 Financials**  3M India Limited reported robust financial performance for Q1 FY2027 (ended June 30, 2026), with total income from operations increasing by approximately 18.5% and net profit after tax rising significantly by 31.1% year-over-year. However, a material impact on the net profit growth is an exceptional, one-time gain of Rs. 73.13 crores from the sale of land, which substantially boosted the reported earnings. Investors should note that operational profit growth without this exceptional item would be less pronounced.
